item.title: Cal AI’s 19-year-old founder just raised $10M for his new AI startup
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort
item.description: Zach Yadegari, the teen co-founder of popular Cal AI calorie tracking app, has launched a new personal AI agent startup that competes with Instinct, Muse and Bee.

item.title: 5 days to TechCrunch Disrupt 2026: Don’t pay more at the door for your pass
item.dc:creator: TechCrunch Events
item.description: The global tech ecosystem gathers at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 at San Francisco’s Moscone West on October 13-15. Get your pass now to save up to $100. Get a second of the same ticket type to save 50%.

item.title: Google releases a new local-first Granola competitor
item.dc:creator: Ivan Mehta
item.description: Google’s new AI Edge Foresight app takes on Granola with an offline meeting note-taker that can transcribe conversations, generate notes, and answer questions using on-device AI.

item.title: China’s Manus raises over $500M in first funding round since split with Meta
item.dc:creator: Kate Park
item.description: Boyu Capital and IDG Capital led the funding round, and existing shareholders Tencent, HSG (formerly known as Sequoia China), ZhenFund, and others also participated.

item.title: Last call to volunteer at TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026
item.dc:creator: TechCrunch Events
item.description: TechCrunch Founder Summit is gearing up to return to Boston on November 4! We’re doing a last call for exceptional volunteers to join us in bringing this event to life. If you’ve ever wondered about the inner workings of tech events, now’s your chance to get involved. Volunteer spots are limited, so don’t miss out! […]

item.title: Amazon unveils new Alexa tablets with Alexa+ and Google Play Store access
item.dc:creator: Aisha Malik
item.description: The lineup includes three models: Amazon Alexa Tablet 12 Pro, Amazon Alexa Tablet 11, and Amazon Alexa Tablet 8.

item.title: Uber and China’s Pony.ai plan to launch robotaxis in London
item.dc:creator: Kirsten Korosec
item.description: The two companies said on Thursday that they would begin testing Pony.ai's Gen-7 robotaxis in London in the coming weeks.

item.title: Vesta raises $30M to bring swarms of agents to mortgage lenders
item.dc:creator: Dominic-Madori Davis
item.description: Vesta, an AI-native software startup that helps lenders originate mortgages, announced a $30 million round led by Conversion Capital.

item.title: India rejects Elon Musk’s claim of discrimination over Starlink launch
item.dc:creator: Jagmeet Singh
item.description: Starlink is still awaiting security clearance before it can seek spectrum and begin commercial services in India.

item.title: Robot data startup Mecka AI nabs $60M from Sequoia
item.dc:creator: Marina Temkin
item.description: Mecka AI collects and analyzes human motion data to train humanoid robots and other kinds of robots. The startup pays people to record everyday tasks.

item.title: While VCs crowd into San Francisco, Endeavor Catalyst raises $320M for founders ‘elsewhere’
item.dc:creator: Connie Loizos
item.description: Endeavor Catalyst just raised $320 million to keep backing founders outside Silicon Valley. Half the profits go back to the nonprofit that finds them.

item.title: Nous Research confirms it hit $1.5B valuation, launches AI agents for business users
item.dc:creator: Marina Temkin
item.description: The developer of Hermes Agent raised a $90 million Series B.

item.title: Microsoft releases new Nvidia-chip AI PCs with revamped Windows 11
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort
item.description: Microsoft revealed the specs and price for its Surface Laptop Ultra, AI PCs that run on Nvidia chips that are designed to run AI models and agents.

item.title: Meta’s Muse launches on iPad just a month after its mobile debut
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Meta’s AI agent Muse is now available on iPad, just a month after its mobile debut, as the company rapidly expands the assistant’s reach and integrations.

item.title: ChatGPT for Teens keeps teens talking, even during mental health crises
item.dc:creator: Rebecca Bellan
item.description: ChatGPT’s teen safeguards are meant to protect vulnerable users, but new testing found the chatbot continues encouraging engagement during crises and potentially encourages unhealthy relationships with the AI itself.

item.title: X expands its ‘Gametime’ sports hub beyond the NFL, starting with MLB
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: X is turning its NFL-focused Gametime feature into a year-round sports destination, starting with MLB and with other professional leagues to follow.

item.title: ChatGPT is getting a lot more visual, with the launch of a new interface
item.dc:creator: Lucas Ropek
item.description: OpenAI is launching a new user interface that will bring interactive visuals to ChatGPT.

item.title: Greenairy is building smart plant towers to clean the air in your office
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ha
item.description: As it turns out, the cure for stuffy, chemical-infused office air might be a tower of leafy greenery.

item.title: CIA officer admits to creating fake top secret government program to steal over $190M, including gold bars
item.dc:creator: Zack Whittaker
item.description: CIA officer David Rush, who worked on highly sensitive intelligence programs, reached a plea deal with U.S. prosecutors after he was caught siphoning money and gold with a fake government contract.

item.title: Meta rolls out new AI tools to detect ads that secretly lead to child sexual abuse material
item.dc:creator: Lauren Forristal
item.description: Meta launches new AI tools after discovering ads on its platforms that may look normal but direct users to harmful content elsewhere online.
